121.o: A packaging redesign for a tea brand with blends for morning, midday and night. It includes logo experiments, a brand board and a swirling color pattern for each blend.
121.t: A concept packaging design for a tea brand with blends to be enjoyed at either morning, midday and night. This was designed for people who are feeling under the weather who needed a pick me up to help them get through the day. It includes logo experiments, a brand board and a swirling color pattern for each blend.
